name: code-miner
description: Runs static analysis over a git-tracked repository source tree and returns candidate objects-of-interest as an AcquisitionResult (code:repo/code:module/code:symbol/code:package nodes; code:contains/code:imports/code:exports/code:depends_on edges; format node-props; code-resource://<repoId>@<gitSha> provenance). Reads the graph nothing (INV-A1); only runAcquisition authors its facts. The guaranteed tier (git + node builtins) needs no external tools; rg/tokei/scc/cloc are probed and skipped-with-reason (N5) behind KIP_INDEX_TOOLS.
